baseline.workflow: Studio-first: Roblox Studio + Studio MCP + Codex CLI + GitHub documentation/source synchronization

design.oneLineFantasy: Pick up junk, turn a tiny scrapyard into an automated recycling empire, and hunt increasingly rare scrap.
earlyCurrencies: Company Stars after prestige is introduced
design.firstSliceTarget: spawn -> yard -> collect -> backpack -> unload/process -> Cash -> first purchase -> visible improvement

completed: Studio MCP and Codex CLI connection manually verified

nextBatch.name: Studio project foundation + one-loop greybox
steps: Query current GitHub main and read canonical project docs
List open Roblox Studio instances through MCP and explicitly select the intended target
Inspect Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ServerScriptService, StarterPlayer and StarterGui
Establish clean Junkyard Empire project namespace/module skeleton
Greybox one personal yard and one starter scrap area
Implement server-authoritative Cash and a tiny scrap catalog
Implement scrap collection, backpack, unload/process and one purchase pad
Implement one visible upgrade and minimal HUD
Run the full P0 route in Play through Studio MCP
Inspect Output/errors and document what was actually verified

criticalRules: Inspect current GitHub main and actual Studio before modifying
Server owns Cash, rewards, purchases, progression, prestige, saves and monetization fulfillment
External assets are encouraged for visuals but imported code is untrusted until audited
Do not layer duplicate replacement systems; remove obsolete implementation when replacing it
Do not claim completion without the required Studio playtest
Update status docs after each meaningful implementation batch
Do not expand content before the core route is stable and understandable
